name: Cockspurthorn
desc: Cockspurthorn (Crataegus crus-galli): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 12 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Crataegus crus-galli is a species of hawthorn known by the common names cockspur hawthorn, cockspur thorn, Newcastle hawthorne, Newcastle thorn, hog apple.
